scope: Isolierter Browser mit nativer Empfangswarteschlange und synthetischen Spielen; keine Live-Dienste.
checks: Pause-duration changes retain every row, player and name text node
Pause-duration changes reuse and update the existing clock
Pause-duration changes use cached bindings without per-ID row queries
Repeated settings preserve rows and clocks without removing those elements
Shortening a pause hides its existing clock without replacing the row or name
Extending a pause reactivates the same clock without a duplicate timer
Disabling official check-in retains names and immediately disables their existing buttons
Re-enabling official check-in reuses the same working click handler
Timer-language changes retain all rows, names and player clocks
Pause reset clears the local pause values and clock while retaining all rows and names
Pause reset uses cached bindings without per-ID row queries
Plan, number, round and discipline update their existing cells without replacing players or score nodes
Metadata patches preserve text objects and scores and update the accessible match label
A metadata patch updates an active search filter without rebuilding the game
A changed preparation timer start updates its existing clock and preserves every player and name
Sorting moves the existing row and its player elements
Sorting finds its row through the existing binding index
A second rendering added in the same task is immediately included in cached score updates
Newly inserted match renderings require no full per-ID document search
Alternate match identifiers resolve every existing rendering through the same index
Changing a binding ID updates the cache before the next update in the same task
Removed rows are evicted and receive no further score changes
Updating a field retains its fixed row and finds it through the field index
A full view change evicts old bindings and updates only the newly mounted score
A discipline change updates blocking explanations while retaining their player, name and badge
All native update receipts follow completed UI work without failures
